parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The status of the virtual node. Valid values:

- Pending

- Ready

- Failed

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The list of tags that are attached to the virtual node.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 20.

> The response might contain fewer entries than the specified number.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You can obtain the token from the \`NextToken\` parameter in the response to the previous request.

You do not need to set this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, you can obtain the token from the response.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are attached to the virtual node.

parameters.name: VirtualNodeIds
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: VirtualNodeName
parameters.description: The IDs of the virtual nodes. You can specify up to 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string.
